data.name: Adi
data.gender_notes: Adi is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Adi is a Hebrew name meaning 'Noble, gentle'. It appears in the Bible as a name for various characters, including Adi the son of Jeduthun, who was a musician and temple servant (1 Chronicles 15:17). This name is often given to girls in the Christian tradition due to its biblical and spiritual significance. The name Adi carries the meaning “Noble, gentle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Adi usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Adi belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adi total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
